content: Bɛ̃yãmɛɛ buiↄ
Bɛ̃yãmɛɛ nɛgↄ̃ɛ sɛ̃́ian Bɛla ũ, a plaade Asebe, a àaↄ̃de Ahala,
a síiↄ̃de Nↄha, a sↄode Lafa.
Bɛla nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Adaa, Ehudu mae Gela,
Abisua, Naamani, Ahoa,
Gela, Sefufã ń Hulaũo.
Ehudu nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Naamani, Ahia ń Gelao. Gelapi nɛgↄ̃ɛↄn Uza ń Aihuduo ũ. Uabeleↄn ń ũ Gɛba, ↄ̃ Gela tò aa fɛ̀lɛ tà Manaata.
Saalaiũ a naↄ Husiũ ń Baalao yà, ↄ̃ à nɛ́ɛ beeↄ ì Mↄabu bùsuu
ń a na Odɛsio: Yobaba, Zibia, Mɛsa, Malekaũ,
Yeuzi, Sakia ń Miimao. Aà nɛ́piↄn we, ampii uabeleↄnɛ.
À Abitubu ń Ɛlipaao ì ń a na Husiũpio zadↄ̃ i aà yao.
Ɛlipaa nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Ɛbɛlu, Misaũ ń Sɛmɛdi pↄ́ Onↄ ń Lodio kàlɛ ń a bualoũↄ.
À Bɛlia ń Sɛmao ì lↄ. Uabeleↄn ń ũ Ayaloni. Aamɛ Gatadeↄ yà.
Bɛlia nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Ahio, Sasaki, Yelemↄ, Zebadia, Alade, Edɛɛ, Mikaila, Isepa ń Yohao.
Ɛlipaa nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Zebadia, Mɛsulaũ, Iziki, Ɛbɛɛ, Isimɛlai, Izilia ń Yobabao.
Simɛi nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Yakiũ, Zikeli, Zabedi, Ɛlienai, Ziletai, Ɛliɛli, Adaia, Bɛlaia ń Simɛlao.
Sasaki nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Isepã, Ɛbɛlu, Ɛliɛli, Abedↄ̃, Zikeli, Anana, Anania, Elaũ, Anɛtotia, Ifedea ń Penuɛlio.
Yeloaũ nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Samɛselai, Sealia, Atalia, Yaalɛsia, Ɛlia ń Zikelio.
Wà gbɛ̃́piↄ tↄ́ dàlau. Uabeleↄnɛ ḿpii. Aa kú ń gbɛ̃́ↄ saɛ Yelusalɛũɛ.
Saulu buiↄ
Kɛ́ Yeiɛli Gabaↄ̃ↄ kàlɛ, ↄ̃ a ku we. Aà na tↄ́n Maaka.
Aà nɛgↄ̃ɛ sɛ̃́ian Abedↄ̃ ũ. A gbɛa Zuu, Kisi, Baali, Nɛɛ, Nadabu,
Gedoo, Ahio, Zekɛɛ
ń Simɛa mae Mikeloo. Aa kú ń gbɛ̃́ↄ saɛ Yelusalɛũɛ.
Nɛɛ Kisi ì, Kisi Saulu ì, Saulu Yonatãa ì ń Malakisuao ń Abinadabuo ń Isibosɛo.
Yonatãa mɛ́ Mika mae Mɛfibosɛ ì.
Mikapi nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Pitↄ̃, Mɛlɛki, Talea ń Aazao.
Aaza Yoada ì, Yoada Alemɛ ì ń Azemavɛo ń Zimlio. Zimli Mↄza ì,
Mↄza Binɛa ì, Binɛa Lafa ì, Lafa Ɛlasa ì, Ɛlasa Aseli ì.
Aseli nɛgↄ̃ɛ ì sooloɛ. An tↄ́n kɛ: Azikaũ, Bokelu, Isimaɛla, Sealia, Obadia ń Ananio. Aseli nɛgↄ̃ɛↄn we píi.
Aà gbɛ̃do Ɛsɛki nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ tↄ́n kɛ: Aà nɛgↄ̃ɛ sɛ̃́ian Ulaũ ũ, a plaade Yeusi, a àaↄ̃de Ɛlifele.
Ulaũ nɛgↄ̃ɛↄá gↄ̃sa gbãa kàdↄ̃naↄnɛ. Aa nɛgↄ̃ɛↄ ń tↄũnaↄ vĩ dasi, aa kà basoplakwi. Gbɛ̃́piↄá Bɛ̃yãmɛɛ buiↄnɛ ḿpii.
